source_or_derivation: Derived from immutable EnsemblID and profile_version
definition: Stable identifier for one versioned target evidence profile.
interpretation_boundary: Identity only; it contains no scientific assessment.

definition: Version of the profile architecture and state-resolution rules.
interpretation_boundary: A newer version is not inherently better or more mature.

definition: Only immutable target join key.
interpretation_boundary: Gene symbols may be displayed separately but never replace or join this key.

definition: Section containing the component.
interpretation_boundary: Section membership does not create independent evidence.

definition: Component represented by this long-form target-component row.
interpretation_boundary: A component is an organizational view, not a vote.

definition: Evidence-availability and uncertainty state for this component.
interpretation_boundary: The state is not favorable/unfavorable and has no numerical ordering.

source_or_derivation: Bounded claims, records, missingness, and uncertainty
definition: Traceable explanation for the component state.
interpretation_boundary: Narrative must not exceed the source-supported claim.

definition: Ontology domains represented by the component.
interpretation_boundary: Multiple domains are not additive support.

definition: Evidence types eligible for the component.
interpretation_boundary: Eligibility does not mean that evidence was observed.

definition: Bounded claims linked to the component.
interpretation_boundary: A claim is an evidence state, not a therapeutic conclusion.

definition: Atomic evidence records linked to the component.
interpretation_boundary: Record count does not measure evidence quality or independence.

definition: Source entities underlying linked records.
interpretation_boundary: Different source IDs still require dependency review.

definition: Version/release for every external or derived source.
interpretation_boundary: Unknown versions make interpretation incomplete.

definition: Governed input artifacts used to construct the component.
interpretation_boundary: Artifact presence does not add scientific evidence.

source_or_derivation: Task #018 artifact manifest and task session
definition: Frozen content hashes matching each input artifact.
interpretation_boundary: A hash establishes content identity, not scientific validity.

definition: Source/record missingness retained without collapse.
interpretation_boundary: NOT_FOUND and NOT_QUERIED are not negative biological evidence.

definition: Known uncertainty categories attached to the component.
interpretation_boundary: Uncertainty is not converted into a confidence penalty.

definition: Relationships among linked evidence records.
interpretation_boundary: Absence of an edge does not prove independence.

definition: Qualitative dependency levels for linked records.
interpretation_boundary: Levels are not numerical weights or penalties.

definition: Whether a material evidence conflict is documented.
interpretation_boundary: FALSE means no defined conflict was found, not universal agreement.

definition: Preserves the nature and source of any conflict.
interpretation_boundary: Conflicts must not be averaged away or silently removed.

definition: Whether minimum provenance is present for every linked record.
interpretation_boundary: Complete provenance does not establish evidence quality.

source_or_derivation: Count of linked atomic evidence records
definition: Audit count of records represented in the component.
interpretation_boundary: Quantity is not quality, confidence, independence, or support strength.

source_or_derivation: Count of linked records with observed status
definition: Audit count of observed bounded records.
interpretation_boundary: More observed records do not imply stronger evidence.

source_or_derivation: Component states, provenance, uncertainty, and missingness
definition: Qualitative description of what is sufficiently characterized and what remains unresolved.
interpretation_boundary: Maturity is evidence availability, not target quality or development merit.

definition: Evidence-type boundaries applicable to the component.
interpretation_boundary: Boundaries constrain claims and cannot be waived by record quantity.

definition: Versioned generator that materialized the profile.
interpretation_boundary: Generator identity does not validate its scientific logic.

definition: Timestamp for the generated profile snapshot.
interpretation_boundary: Recency does not make evidence independent or stronger.
